coverage_note: 00:00-06:26 English chat about a song (Medi's Arabic there is fragments: جاهز, عالم, أرض, البيت - no fixes). Speaking stretch 06:26-10:40 (date, time, weather, clothes). 11:13-1:00:35 is a LISTENING drill of the make-X/get-X verbs: Amal says a sentence, Medi translates to English, so most rows are mode=listening (his misreadings she corrected). Not written: 07:26 الساعة تنتين وتلت (right); 08:54 'أبل امبارح or أبل امبارح؟' is a question answered 'قبل امبارح or أول امبارح' (not a slip); 09:56-10:05 بياض/أبيض/بيضة he questioned then reached بيضة himself before her 'بيضة' (self-fix/question, not written); 10:08 بلوزة -> قميص رسمي self-fix; 14:17 'back sir' (bakser) vs Amal 'اكسر' unclear, not written; 21:01 'does that become pointer' is a rule question; 23:29 أزهق question; 41:23 'bakharat and bakharat, right?' question; 57:40 'double T or one T?' question; 1:02:02 شوفك for أشوفك = S4 pronunciation. كمان مرة؟ at 21:48, 23:59, 34:12, 35:18, 39:41, 55:35, 57:30 = 'again?', not slips. Engine notes: 09:15 خمارة = his guess at ريحته; 10:25 كمي = his half-said ghaame2; 20:04 بيساع = his echo of بيزعل; 38:13 'Matahammasi' = ما تحمسي; 38:40 'ume mit as kamamara?' = كمان مرة؟; 38:48 'أُمه safulu' = اتأسفوا لي; 47:22 'Is that it's just too much fucked' = his echo of زعجتو; 49:06 'My choose Aloo' = ما تزعلوا (asking about the ending); 51:24 Amal عمسني = حمسني (chat 7ammasni); 53:51 'home.' = -hom ending of زهقتهم; 30:40 '[in Spanish]' is an engine tag, not a word. echo: 'ume mit as kamamara' = كمان مرة؟; echo: 'Asafulu' = اتأسفوا لي. Echo-candidate list: 'Oh, the smell.', 'Or who enjoyed?', 'Bored.', 'Smile.', 'Oh, they enjoyed...' are real English; take_verb and laazem_noun lists are empty. No tier-3 English-in-Arabic rows: his English is meta/translation, not filler. Names: Palestine, Spanish - not vocabulary.

rows.medi_said: This is it today. تسعة عشرين. ... تسعة عشر. ... تسعش or تسعش.
rows.amal_said: تسعطاش تسعة.
rows.why: For the date 19 he first said tes3a 3eshreen (9-20), then MSA tes3a 3ashar, then tes3ash; Amal recast the dialect number tese3ta3sh (her sheet: nineteen | tese3ta3sh) and he echoed it at 07:15.

rows.medi_said: تسعش ستة.
rows.amal_said: ستة؟ ... تسعطاش تسعة.
rows.why: Giving the date he said month six (sitte) for September (nine); Amal questioned 'ستة؟' at 07:04 then recast تسعطاش تسعة and he repeated it at 07:15, so she heard six - not the engine.

rows.medi_said: بتغي-- بتغير كتير. No, بغير كتير. It's masculine.
rows.amal_said: The؟ It changed؟ ... So تغير، no be.
rows.chat: el-jaw el-yoam t8ayyar kteer u shob mish m8ayyem
rows.why: He put the present b- on a past event (the weather changed) and then re-cut it to b8ayyer thinking the bt- was feminine; Amal prompted 'It changed?' and named it 'تغير، no be', he said 'past tense, you're right' and gave تغير كتير at 08:18.
rows.english: the weather changed a lot today

rows.medi_said: Wait. Okay. خمارة? ... شو يعني ريحته؟
rows.amal_said: ريحة. ريحت.
rows.why: Didn't-know: he asked what ree7to meant and she supplied ree7a (smell); sheet row 'smell | ree7a | ريحة'. Engine wrote خمارة for his first guess at the word.

rows.medi_said: uh، بنطلون، uh، أزرق، uh، كمي
rows.amal_said: غامق.
rows.chat: el-yoam balbes 2amees rasmi abyad u ban6aloan azra2 8aame2 u kundara binniyye
rows.why: Reaching for 'dark' after azra2 he produced a half form the engine wrote as كمي (his 'ghaami'); Amal supplied غامق and he repeated it; sheet row 'dark (color) | 8aameq | غامق'. Could also be read as a didn't-know (tier 0).

rows.medi_said: you took a photo or I, I take a photo? I had taken a photo? ... So it's اتصورت, right? ... There's no preposition.
rows.amal_said: صورت. ... Is it did you take a photo or did you get-- did you take a photo of yourself؟ Like, did you get photographed؟
rows.why: He read the t- form tsawwaret as 'took a photo' (sawwar); Amal contrasted صورت and prompted get-vs-take until he said 'I got photographed' at 12:10.

rows.medi_said: you are tired of me.
rows.amal_said: No that's تعبت مني. تعبتني. ... بس is it present or past؟
rows.why: ta33abetni (you made me tired, object -ni) heard as te3ebt minni (you got tired of me); Amal said no, gave the contrast, then prompted the tense until he said 'You tired me' at 13:10.
rows.english: you tired me / you wore me out

rows.medi_said: Why did you smile to a male or why did she smile?
rows.amal_said: Is it did or do؟ ... Why are you smiling؟ Why do you smile؟
rows.why: He heard the b- present bted7ak as past; Amal prompted 'did or do?' and he fixed to 'Why do you smile? Present tense.' at 15:58.

rows.medi_said: Isn't this to inflict sadness? The past tense. ... Okay, I was sad.
rows.amal_said: That's زهقت. زهقت. ... زهقت مش زعلت. زهقت.
rows.right: I was bored / you were bored
rows.why: He took zhe2et for z3elet (sad) and also for the make-form zahha2 ('inflict'); Amal said زهقت مش زعلت and he gave 'I was bored or you were bored' at 16:52.

rows.medi_said: They had fun or they enjoyed?
rows.amal_said: آآآ. Close بس that would be انبسطوا. انبسطوا
rows.why: Amal said 'close, that would be انبسطوا' and he re-read it as 'you guys enjoyed' (enbasa6tu); the engine and her chat line both show enbes6u (they), so it is unclear which person she drilled - low confidence.
rows.english: you (pl) had fun / they had fun

rows.medi_said: بيساع ... What boring hap-- What happened boring?
rows.amal_said: بيزعل. ... No، بيزعل، مش بيزهق. ... What happened is بيزعل. Or saddening.
rows.why: He echoed beyza33el as بيساع and then read it as beyzahhe2 (boring); Amal said بيزعل مش بيزهق and he gave 'what happened is sad' at 20:39.

rows.medi_said: He will not, he will not bore you.
rows.amal_said: Very close. أزهقك، not يزهقك. أزهقك. ... I won't bore you. ما راح أزهقك.
rows.why: He heard the a- (I) prefix of azahhe2ak as y- (he); Amal said 'أزهقك، not يزهقك' and gave 'I won't bore you'.

rows.medi_said: he will not be bored of you. Is that...
rows.amal_said: ما راح يكون زهقان منك. He will not be bored of you.
rows.wrong: he will not be bored of you
rows.why: Didn't-know: he asked how 'he will not be bored of you' would go and Amal built it with ykoon + zah2aan (sheet: bored | Zahqaan | زهقان); no attempt of his own, tier 0.
rows.english: he will not be bored of you

rows.medi_said: Were you sad from what happened?
rows.amal_said: Very close. بس مش sad. انزعجتي. ... Did you get annoyed from what happened؟
rows.why: enza3ajti (you got annoyed) read as 'sad' (z3elti); Amal said 'مش sad' and he gave 'are you annoyed?' at 24:22, she recast 'did you get annoyed'.
rows.english: did you get annoyed by what happened?

rows.medi_said: so don't be tired of me.
rows.amal_said: That's ما تتعبي مني. ما تعبيني. ... Don't tire me.
rows.right: don't tire me (don't make me tired)
rows.why: ma t3abbini (don't make me tired, -ni object) heard as ma tet3abi minni (don't get tired of me); Amal contrasted the two and he reached 'Don't tire me, don't make me tired' at 25:05.

rows.medi_said: She laughed at him.
rows.amal_said: علي. ... علي and عليه. إي، إي.
rows.why: He heard 3alayy (at me) as 3aleh (at him); Amal recast علي and he fixed to 'She laughed at me', then said he never gets 3alayy vs 3aleh.

rows.medi_said: Who was he mad with you-- at you? ... So daya is to be upset.
rows.amal_said: What's ضايقك؟ ... So is it ضايق or it's ضايقة to be upset؟ ... So مين ضايقك؟
rows.right: daaya2 = to make someone upset (who made you upset?)
rows.why: He read daaya2 (make upset) as 'be upset/mad'; Amal prompted daaya2 vs etdaaya2 and he fixed to 'who made you upset' at 28:17.

rows.medi_said: Don't be angry at me or don't make me angry.
rows.amal_said: mm-hmm. Don't make me angry.
rows.why: For ma t3assebni he offered both 'be angry at me' and 'make me angry'; Amal picked only the make-form, so the first reading was the slip - low because he had the right one in the same breath.

rows.medi_said: I am happy... No. ... Basat is to be made happy, right? ... So بسطت is I was happy.
rows.amal_said: مهم. So بسطت first. ... I made.
rows.why: basa6to (I made him happy) read as 'I was happy'; Amal cued 'I made' and he said 'this is inflicting ... I made him happy' at 32:46.

rows.medi_said: You guys...
rows.amal_said: بينبسطوا.
rows.why: He started reading byenbes6u as 'you guys' (bten-); Amal repeated the verb and he fixed to 'they are happy when they see me' at 33:41.
rows.english: they get happy when they see me

rows.medi_said: Matahammasi... Uh, لسه ما... er ما تحمسي لسه
rows.amal_said: ما تتحمسي لسه. [تضحك] طيب.
rows.why: Translating her 'Don't be excited yet' he dropped the t- of the get-form (t7ammasi = make excited, tet7ammasi = get excited); Amal recast ما تتحمسي لسه and he repeated 'Oh, that's right. ما تتحمسي' at 38:24.

rows.medi_said: Wait. Asafulu. Yeah, they apologized. Present tense.
rows.amal_said: لأ. ... اتأسفوا، not بيتأسفوا.
rows.why: He re-labelled t2assafuli as present; Amal said لأ, 'اتأسفوا not بيتأسفوا', and he took it back ('I said it with the first tense').

rows.medi_said: I ruined the, the s- the trip. ... Oh, khirbat. Uh, she ruined the trip.
rows.amal_said: Are you sure؟ I ruined؟ ... No؟ That would be خربت. خربت.
rows.wrong: I ruined the trip / she ruined the trip
rows.why: Her 5irbat el-safra (the trip got ruined) was read as 'I ruined' then 'she ruined' (5arrabat); Amal prompted twice and he got 'the trip was ruined?' at 40:14, then built إنتي خربتي السفرة on her ask.

rows.medi_said: Who, yeah, who was made happy or who enjoyed from us?
rows.amal_said: With us. معنا.
rows.why: He heard ma3na as minna ('whoops, I was saying mina'); Amal recast معنا = with us. His 'who was made happy' for enbasa6 was also nudged by her repeat انبسط at 42:32.

rows.medi_said: Uh, are you excited to a girl?
rows.amal_said: Did you get excited؟
rows.why: t7ammasti (past, you got excited) read as the present state 'are you excited'; Amal recast 'Did you get excited?' and he took it at 43:25.

rows.medi_said: Why are you tired?
rows.amal_said: متعب. ... What's tired؟ ... It could be both 'cause I'm not specifying إنت أو هو.
rows.right: why is it tiring / why are you tiring
rows.why: mut3eb (tiring, the make-participle) read as ta3baan (tired); Amal repeated متعب and asked 'what's tired?', he gave تعبان and then 'why is it tiring'. B15 is not taught yet - filed, not counted.

rows.medi_said: بزهق ... بزهّق ... Is it zar-zarha, zar'a?
rows.amal_said: Yeah. That's boring. ... زهقان. [تضحك] Of course it's that's it. It's بس زهق، زهق.
rows.why: Asked for the adjective 'bored' he gave the verb bazha2/bazahhe2; Amal said 'that's boring', he groped for 'zar'a' and she supplied زهقان (sheet: bored | Zahqaan | زهقان), which he repeated at 45:12.

rows.medi_said: Not it as a don't be angry.
rows.amal_said: ما تتأسف.
rows.why: He guessed ma tet2assaf as 'don't be angry'; Amal only repeated it and he fixed to 'Oh, أسف. Don't apologize' at 47:00 (sheet: i apologize | Bat2assaf | بتأسف).

rows.medi_said: uh, you guys don't, uh, don't be annoyed.
rows.amal_said: Annoyed؟
rows.why: ma tez3alu (don't get sad/upset) read as 'annoyed' (tenze3ju); Amal queried 'Annoyed?' and he fixed to 'don't be sad from it or from him' at 49:38.

rows.medi_said: She was happy. ... I enjoyed to it. No, Aloo, uh, Bill. Are you saying Bill?
rows.amal_said: No، انبسطت له. انبسطت له. Just the verb. I got happy له. ... For، for him.
rows.wrong: She was happy / I enjoyed to it
rows.why: He read enbasa6etlo as 'she was happy' then 'I enjoyed to it'; Amal said no, 'just the verb, I got happy له', and gave le- = for him, which he took at 50:53.

rows.medi_said: You guys don't be annoyed. ... you guys don't be annoying.
rows.amal_said: تزعجوه، not تنزعجوا، تزعجوه. ... توه، تزعجوه.
rows.why: ma tez3ejuh (don't annoy him, object -uh) read as ma tenze3ju (don't get annoyed); Amal said 'تزعجوه، not تنزعجوا' and pointed at the -uh ending until he said 'don't be annoying to him' at 53:17.

rows.medi_said: They made us sad.
rows.amal_said: زعلوني.
rows.why: He heard the -ni (me) ending as -na (us); Amal repeated زعلوني and he fixed to 'They made me sad' at 54:24.

rows.medi_said: So it made me happy... ... Present. Oh, it makes me happy you came. Aji, you said, 'It makes me happy he came.'
rows.amal_said: صح، it made happy، بس is it past or present؟ ... آجي. I come. It makes me happy like coming makes me happy
rows.wrong: it made me happy ... he came
rows.right: it makes me happy that I come
rows.why: byebse6ni (present b-) read as 'made', then aaji (I come, bare after enno) read as 'he came'; Amal prompted past-or-present and recast آجي = I come, and he landed on 'it's fun for me when I come' at 56:49.
rows.english: it makes me happy to come

rows.medi_said: did you guys enjoy me or did you guys have f- uh... Yeah. Did you guys
rows.amal_said: Mhm. Have fun with.
rows.why: enbasa6tu ma3i read as 'enjoy me' without the 'with'; Amal supplied 'have fun with' and he added 'Me?' - low because he was already reaching for 'have fun'.
rows.english: did you (pl) have fun with me?

rows.medi_said: Did, uh, did you guys enjoy to me? Did you guys... I don't understand this one.
rows.amal_said: انبسطولي. انبسطولي. ... They got-- they were happy for me.
rows.wrong: did you guys enjoy to me
rows.why: enbasa6uli (they got happy for me) read as 'you guys ... to me': wrong person (-u = they) and le- read as 'to' instead of 'for'; Amal recast 'they were happy for me' and he took 'Oh, for me' at 1:00:03.
